record.one_liner: Devin provides REST APIs allowing programmatic interaction for managing sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, analytics, audit logs, and more using service users or Personal Access Tokens.
record.blocker: Pricing/signup access tiers for self-serve testing and shipping are not specified in the documentation.
